title: Wise design system / presentation film

location.extent: Complete published video; PNG is one poster frame

slide_intent: Connect expressive assets to repeatable guidance because a recognizable identity must survive many authors and contexts.
strategic_value: Showing components, guidelines and live applications together can explain how Wise’s visual freedom is supported by a system.
demonstration: The film moves through global-use claims, interface modules, color and type examples, guideline screens, advertising and product photography. The retained poster shows the typography guidance screen.
practical_value: Distinguish a promotional system overview from complete implementation guidance; verify any shown rule in its original context before reuse.

content_islands.name: Purpose and components
content_islands.spec: Introduce system ambitions before assembling product modules.

content_islands.name: Guideline views
content_islands.spec: Show the archived guideline navigation, specimens and line-height screen.

content_islands.name: Applications
content_islands.spec: End with outdoor placements, mobile use and a mosaic of brand assets.

reference_purposes.Expression: The film moves through global-use claims, interface modules, color and type examples, guideline screens, advertising and product photography. The retained poster shows the typography guidance screen.
reference_purposes.Intent: The film explicitly links the design system to global usability and less frustrating design work.
reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates guideline screens and modules applied across product and campaigns.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The archived guideline screen within the film specifies headline line-height: 80% for larger display sizes, 90% for smaller sub-headings, and 80–90% between them. This is historical on-screen guidance, not a rule for all text.

ingredient.name: Headline line-height
ingredient.role: Keep large display words visually compact.
ingredient.application: The filmed guideline specifies 80% for larger display sizes, 90% for smaller sub-headings, and values between those for intermediate sizes.
ingredient.scope: Historical guideline screen at about 51–52 seconds in this presentation. Do not apply to body text; the complete original guideline site is unavailable.
